reason: I'd probably take the free audit because I've got two clients I'm fairly sure are underpaying, but I'm not signing up to a monthly subscription off the back of a pitch. I've paid for a reporting tool before that nobody opened after setup, so I'll judge it on whether the audit report holds up when my service manager goes through it.
objection: Our ticket categories are a mess, so I expect the numbers to be wrong: half the 'out of scope' work will be miscategorised, and I'll spend more time arguing with the report than with clients.
would_change_my_mind: The free audit flagging my two suspect clients correctly, with tickets and contract clauses that my team checks and agrees with, and a total well above the £2,880 without us having to clean up our PSA first.
